summary.zh: 正式版：侧栏升级为按项目分组——对话按所属项目收拢，正在聊天的组自动展开，重启后回到上次工作的项目；Git 面板重做为「Git 图谱」，提交、推送、拉取在同一个界面按分支状态一键完成，还能让助手写提交信息。新增「会话地图」把长对话折叠成可纵览的轮次卡片图、应用级快捷键（可在设置里改键、带冲突检测）、上下文压缩双阈值（用量过半询问、超八成自动压缩并通知）。实验通道已验证的「编排工具」、按需工具加载、技能热更新与逐个开关、内置搜索组件（rg/fd/ast-grep）随本版进入正式通道。修复：换模型后第一轮思考/工具不进折叠卡、流式进行中思考/工具卡片点击时好时坏、只有置顶对话时侧栏误显示空白等。
summary.en: Stable release: the sidebar now groups conversations by project — the group you are chatting in stays expanded, and the app reopens on the project you worked on last. The Git panel is rebuilt as a unified Git Graph: commit, push and pull in one surface with a branch-aware primary action, plus assistant-written commit messages. New: a Conversation Map that turns long chats into a browsable card graph; app-wide keyboard shortcuts with a settings page and conflict detection; and dual compaction thresholds (ask at 50% usage, auto-compact at 80% with a notice). Features proven on the beta train — the Orchestration tool, on-demand tool loading, per-skill hot toggles, and bundled search binaries (rg/fd/ast-grep) — join the stable channel. Fixes include: first turn after a model switch leaving thoughts/tools unfolded, streaming cards being click-unreliable mid-run, and the pinned-only sidebar wrongly showing an empty state.

title.zh: 侧栏按项目分组，重启回到上次的项目
title.en: Sidebar groups conversations by project and reopens on your last project

summary.zh: 左侧对话列表按所属项目（工作台或目录）收拢成组：当前聊天的组自动展开、其余折叠，点组头即可切换；执行中的对话单独成组置顶提示；置顶对话跨项目常驻列表顶部。重启后自动恢复上次活跃的项目身份，不用再手动找回。
summary.en: The session list now collapses conversations into per-project groups: the group you are chatting in stays expanded while others fold, click a header to switch. Active runs get their own always-expanded group, and pinned conversations stay on top across projects. After a restart the sidebar reopens on the project you worked on last.

details.zh: 分叉出的子对话在主对话行内折叠展示，点主对话行展开/收起。
details.en: Forked child conversations fold into their parent row and expand on click.

details.zh: 删除会话时联动清理其快照侧车；共享同一仓库的快照目录在最后一个引用会话删除时才移除。
details.en: Deleting a session also cleans its snapshot sidecars; shared snapshot repos are removed only when the last referencing session is deleted.

sources.title: feat: 0.1.41 候选批次收口——侧栏项目分组 + Git 图谱面板 + 会话地图 + 快捷键系统 + 压缩双阈值

title.zh: Git 图谱面板：提交、推送、拉取合一
title.en: Git Graph panel: commit, push and pull in one place

summary.zh: Git 面板整体重做：头部是分支胶囊（点击切换/新建），主按钮跟随分支状态——无可推送时是「提交」，本地领先变「同步更改 ↑n」（推送），远程领先变「↓n」（拉取），双向分叉则先拉后推。右上角四角星可让助手生成提交信息；暂存、撤销暂存、amend、按文件丢弃都在行内完成。
summary.en: The Git panel is rebuilt: a branch pill up top for switching or creating branches, and a primary button that follows branch state — commit when there is nothing to push, Sync with ↑n to push when ahead, ↓n to pull when behind, and pull-then-push when diverged. A star button asks the assistant to draft the commit message; staging, unstaging, amending and per-file discard are all inline.

details.zh: 拉取仅自动衔接（fast-forward），分叉或本地脏区时给出明确指引而不是制造合并提交。
details.en: Pull is fast-forward only; divergence or a dirty tree produces clear guidance instead of surprise merge commits.

sources.title: feat: 0.1.41 候选批次收口——侧栏项目分组 + Git 图谱面板 + 会话地图 + 快捷键系统 + 压缩双阈值

title.zh: 会话地图：长对话的轮次总览
title.en: Conversation Map: a turn-level overview of long chats

summary.zh: 新增「会话地图」视图：把一段对话按轮次折叠成卡片图——每张卡片带问题摘要与回答要点，点击直达该轮；布局记忆在本地，重排后下次打开保持。超长对话不再只能靠滚动找回上下文。
summary.en: A new Conversation Map view folds a chat into a graph of turn cards — each card carries the question and answer highlights, click to jump to that turn. Layout is remembered locally. Long conversations no longer need pure scrolling to navigate.

sources.title: feat: 0.1.41 候选批次收口——侧栏项目分组 + Git 图谱面板 + 会话地图 + 快捷键系统 + 压缩双阈值

title.zh: 应用级快捷键：可改键、带冲突检测
title.en: App-wide keyboard shortcuts with remapping and conflict detection

summary.zh: 常用动作（新对话、切会话、打开设置、切换模型等）有了全局快捷键；键位表在设置页集中管理，改键时实时提示冲突，主进程/服务端/渲染层共用同一份键位契约。
summary.en: Common actions (new chat, switch session, open settings, switch model, …) gain global shortcuts. The keymap is managed on a settings page with live conflict detection, and one shared contract feeds the main process, server and renderer.

sources.title: feat: 0.1.41 候选批次收口——侧栏项目分组 + Git 图谱面板 + 会话地图 + 快捷键系统 + 压缩双阈值

title.zh: 上下文压缩双阈值：过半询问、超八成自动
title.en: Dual compaction thresholds: ask at half, auto-compact past 80%

summary.zh: 上下文用量越过 50% 时弹窗询问是否立即压缩（不打断进行中的回答）；到达 80% 则强制自动压缩并通知，硬截断兜底（85%）保持不变。压缩时机从「突然被截」变成「提前知情、可控」。
summary.en: When context usage crosses 50% a dialog offers to compact now (never interrupting a running reply); at 80% compaction runs automatically with a notice. The hard truncation backstop (85%) is unchanged. Compaction goes from a sudden cut to something expected and controllable.

sources.title: feat: 0.1.41 候选批次收口——侧栏项目分组 + Git 图谱面板 + 会话地图 + 快捷键系统 + 压缩双阈值

title.zh: 编排工具（实验通道转正）：一段程序跑完一串工具调用
title.en: Orchestration tool (graduated from beta): one program runs a whole chain of tool calls

summary.zh: 助手可以把多步工作写成一段异步程序一次性执行：循环、并发、条件分支都可以，程序里 await 调用本会话的任意工具。中间结果留在沙箱里不占对话上下文，只有程序打印的内容与最终返回值回到聊天；每一步子调用单独走权限审批，与手动调用同权。
summary.en: The assistant can write one async program that performs multi-step work in a single call — loops, concurrency and conditionals included, awaiting any session tool. Intermediate results stay in a sandbox outside the conversation; only printed output and the return value come back. Every sub-call goes through the same per-call permission gates as manual calls.

details.zh: 聊天里编排工具行下方缩进列出每一步：工具名、成败、耗时，点开可看参数与完整结果。
details.en: Below the orchestration row each sub-step is listed indented with tool name, status and timing, expandable to arguments and full outputs.

sources.title: feat: PTC 程序化工具调用（run_tools）+ run_code/lsp 注册修复 + 内置二进制批次收口

title.zh: 修一批交互时好时坏：流式点击、换模型、置顶空态
title.en: Fixes for intermittent interactions: streaming clicks, model switch, pinned-only empty state

summary.zh: ①流式进行中「思考/工具」卡片点击时好时坏：追底滚动会在按住时把卡片从光标下带走（浏览器视为未命中），且工具组卡片在成员变化时整组重建清掉展开状态——现在按住即冻结滚动、组身份锚定首成员不再换 key。②换模型后第一轮思考/工具不进折叠卡：切换落在轮间空档时清掉四本「进行中」账本。③只有置顶对话时侧栏误显示空白并隐藏置顶条。
summary.en: ① Thinking/tool cards mid-run were click-unreliable: auto-scroll dragged cards out from under the pointer (counted as a miss) and tool-group cards rebuilt on member changes, wiping expanded state — scrolling now freezes while pressed and group identity anchors to the first member. ② The first turn after a model switch left thoughts/tools unfolded; settlement now clears the in-flight ledgers in the between-turns window. ③ A pinned-only sidebar wrongly showed an empty state that hid the pinned strip.

sources.title: feat: 0.1.41 候选批次收口——侧栏项目分组 + Git 图谱面板 + 会话地图 + 快捷键系统 + 压缩双阈值

title.zh: 按需工具加载 + 内置搜索组件（实验通道转正）
title.en: On-demand tool loading and bundled search binaries (graduated from beta)

summary.zh: 常驻工具面瘦身约 76%，不常用的工具按需装载；rg/fd/ast-grep 搜索组件随安装包内置，Windows 子进程退出竞态与 CI 抓取限流已在前置修复中根治。
summary.en: The always-on tool surface shrinks by ~76% with rarely used tools loaded on demand; rg/fd/ast-grep ship inside the installer, with the Windows subprocess race and CI fetch rate limits already fixed in prior patches.

fix: 二进制抓取全链转进程内 fetch——根治 Windows 子进程退出竞态崩溃

title.zh: 工作区技能热更新与逐个开关（实验通道转正）

summary.zh: 工作区技能改动即时生效，不用重启；每个技能可单独开关，关掉的技能不再进提示词也不占工具面。
summary.en: Workspace skills reload instantly without a restart, and each skill has its own toggle — disabled skills leave both the prompt and the tool surface.

summary.zh: 每轮回答下方汇总该轮实际改动的文件清单，点击即看 diff，改了什么一目了然。
summary.en: Each reply ends with a card listing the files it actually edited, with diffs one click away.

summary.en: Checkpoints are captured before bulk tool edits so a whole turn can roll back; the observability sub-tabs keep every step traceable before and after.
